text_block_list.text:
One day, Agnes Tachyon brought me along to 
a certain place...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Man, the weather's gorgeous. Well then, 
shall we get right to it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of conducting an experiment 
here today. Oh, it's nothing too 
complicated.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
For now, show me your limits. The real 
experiment begins from there.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, I'll take it easy and follow behind 
you, so give it everything you've got and 
run!

I ran along the sandy beach, just as Agnes 
Tachyon told me to.

One hour... two hours... My body grows 
steadily heavier, and as I trudge forward—

Hearing Agnes Tachyon's voice from behind, 
I look down at my feet. There, I see—...

...A sea urchin!? Damn it, I can't dodge 
it in time—!

When I open my eyes, the sea urchin is 
right beside me. It seems Agnes Tachyon 
pulled my hand away in the nick of time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Sigh, honestly, you're always such a 
hazard. Please refrain from getting 
injured outside of experiments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You owe me for this. It caught me off 
guard, so my heart rate spiked for no good 
reason—..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The sensation I felt at that moment... 
could it perhaps be of use to the physical 
modification research I am currently 
conducting...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! Fine work, Trainer-kun! We're 
heading back to the lab immediately!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That single instant... I must record it 
properly before I forget!

Having gained something from that 
spontaneous movement, Agnes Tachyon's 
running improved dramatically from that 
day forward...!
